inlineImages.caption: Adipex (Appetite Suppresant)

bodyHtml: by Dr. Trace Curry We have seen great results with hundreds of patients from our Adipex program.  The generic name for Adipex is phentermine, and it has been around for many years.  It is a stimulant, so it can have side-effects if not properly used and monitored.  Also, there are certain restrictions that physicians must abide by with the use of Adipex that vary from state to state. Most patients will lose a minimum of 10 lbs the first month if they are taking the program seriously (i.e. following a healthy diet and exercising). Often times our dietitian will recommend a 5-and-1 program, which means the patient will choose 5 healthy meal replacements from our eStore, and then eat a healthy lean-green-meal for dinner. We have had many patients lose 50-100 lbs with this program!  We offer Adipex & phentermine in all of our office locations:  Cincinnati, Columbus, Dayton, and Northern Kentucky. Dr. Curry
